vagueAll.text: You can only skip a plan of your own, so there’s no Skip It button for a class or an appointment. Press Go, or Stand Here to wait. It happens the next time the clock moves: you’re there if you’re awake, out of hospital and in its town, and if not, you miss it.

Stand Here: the dialog closes and the clock stays paused at the commitment, which stays at the top of the Calendar panel, marked now. It happens the next time the clock moves, and you’re there if you’re awake, in its town, and not kept away by a hospital bed or an injury.
Press one of a question’s answers to act on it there. It does what the same button on its own screen does.

On a standing order’s day, the whole amount moves if the account it pays from has it. If none of it can go, What Needs You says “A Standing Order Didn’t Go” and why, and it tries again next month. That happens when the account is short, either account is dormant or closing, the account it pays from is blocked after a switch because it owes money, or (in a save from before this was ruled out) it pays into a term deposit.
